title: Group Discussion and Streamer Announcements
lead: The group is reflecting on their experience in a horror game, finding it fun despite not finding any ghosts, and is engaging with their chat community.
summaryOneLine: The group is reflecting on their experience in a horror game, finding it fun despite not finding any ghosts, and is engaging with their chat community.
articleBodyHtml:
Reflection on Horror Game Experience

The group is reflecting on their experience in a horror game, finding it fun despite not finding any ghosts, and is engaging with their chat community.

The group is frustrated with Phasmophobia, as they are not finding any ghosts, and is considering giving up on the game.

Discussion of Similar Games

The group is discussing a similar game to Phasmophobia, and is trying to recall its name.

The group is trying to identify a game similar to Phasmophobia, and they are discussing the possibility that it is called 'Ghost Hunt Corp' or 'Ghost Hunt Labyrinth'.

Returning to Content Creation

The speaker is returning to their usual activity or content creation after a break.

Collaboration and Game Discussion

The speaker and Guwa played the game Phasmophobia together, and there was a discussion about the game's changes.

The speaker and the other participants found the game different from before, possibly due to updates, and acknowledged that they might not be good at the game.

Mention of Channels and Future Content

The speaker mentioned their girls' channels and encouraged viewers to check them out, and also mentioned a specific content called 'No Supergiant'.

The speaker is planning to do a content related to 'Nautica' in six hours and mentioned a future event called 'Holocouncil'.

Gratitude and Farewell

The speaker expressed gratitude for an impromptu collaboration and hoped it would cheer up the live fandom.

The speaker mentioned that in German, they say 'Auf Wiedersehen!' (Goodbye!).

relatedStreams.title: Kiaraが「Crash the Party」を改めて紹介　共同制作チームへの信頼を語る
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 長時間のSuperchat readingから、Kiaraが直近の活動を振り返りつつCrash the Partyの共同制作相手をどのように受け止めていたかを短く確認できる

relatedStreams.title: 引いた後にも、次の目的を残す　Kiaraの『Arknights: Endfield』更新配信
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 新要素への反応だけでなく、一つの結果を次の行動へ接続し、長い更新配信の現在地を保つKiaraの進め方を読める

relatedStreams.title: 秒差をそろえ、熱を言葉にする　KiaraとEssieが並走した決勝ウォッチアロング
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: この配信の中心は、どちらの予想が正しかったかではありません。

relatedStreams.title: Nintendo Directをキアラと見届ける　Fire Emblemへの期待と新作映像への反応
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: Nintendo Directを視聴したキアラの期待、9月17日のFire Emblem発売日確認、映像への感想と本人の推測を原文時刻付きで区別して追える。

relatedStreams.title: Kiara、歯のトラブルもGartic Phoneのネタに　Ollieたちとの描画リレーがカオス化
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: 約2時間半の配信から、各ゲームモードの違い、歯ネタが繰り返される経緯、終盤の歯の顛末を短時間で把握できる

relatedStreams.title: 「待たせたくない」が相談に変わる　Kiaraたち4人の『Slay the Spire 2』
relatedStreams.summaryOneLine: deck構築の手順要約ではなく、multiplayer化した『Slay the Spire 2』で相談が判断待ちの不安をteam playへ変える過程を追える
